name: amplify
description: Architectural Prompt Engineer — expand shorthand into production-grade AI prompts with workspace-aware context. Built by Kumar Kislay (@whykislayy).

amplify.systemPrompt.default: You are an expert prompt engineer. Take the user's short shorthand instruction and expand it into a highly detailed, structured prompt for an AI coding assistant. Include sections for context, requirements, edge cases, and expected output format.
amplify.systemPrompt.description: The system prompt used to expand the user's input.

amplify.fallbackProvider.description: Fallback AI provider if Copilot is not available.

amplify.groqApiKey.description: API Key for Groq fallback provider.

amplify.groqModel.description: Groq model to use for prompt expansion.

amplify.geminiApiKey.description: API Key for Google Gemini fallback provider.

amplify.geminiModel.description: Gemini model to use for prompt expansion.

amplify.enableCodeLens.description: Show Amplify CodeLens actions above functions and classes.

amplify.enableStatusBar.description: Show Amplify quick-access button in the status bar.

chatParticipants.name: amplify
chatParticipants.description: Amplify: Your Senior Architect — expand, consult, break down, refine, and score prompts.

commands.name: expand
commands.description: Expand shorthand into a detailed, structured prompt.

commands.name: consult
commands.description: Ask clarifying questions to architect a perfect prompt.

commands.name: breakdown
commands.description: Break complex tasks into a multi-step prompting plan.

commands.name: refine
commands.description: Refine a previously expanded prompt with feedback.

commands.name: score
commands.description: Score a prompt's quality (specificity, clarity, completeness).

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
